booblord.title: Booblord
booblord.notes: A blue-skinned townswoman with long black hair. She carries Garret's Axion staff and uses his moves, with her own voice, idle poses and victory. Pick the Booblord spin weapon for her own spinning attacks: hold attack to chain them, B for a wider sweep. Her hair and body sway as she moves.

booblord_high.title: Booblord High
booblord_high.notes: Booblord with sharper textures and smoother curves. Same moves and sounds. Made for xemu set to 128 MiB.

booblord_human.title: Booblord Human
booblord_human.notes: Booblord with light tan skin and brown eyes. Same body, moves and sounds.

booblord_high_human.title: Booblord High Human
booblord_high_human.notes: Booblord High with light tan skin and brown eyes. Same moves and sounds. Made for xemu set to 128 MiB.
